errors.text_span: като стълбовете за 2020 г. са най-високи в почти всички категории
errors.evidence: This statement claims that the bars for 2020 are the highest in 'almost all' categories. However, in two of the six categories ('Видин' and 'Враца'), the bar for 2019 is visibly higher than the bar for 2020. Therefore, the 2020 bar is the highest in only four out of six categories, making 'almost all' an over-generalization.
